Hi Harriet — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the W-9. We're initiating the vendor master intake. A couple of requests to make the PO ingestion and ERP mapping smooth: 

1) Can you confirm the legal entity exactly as it should appear on contracts (name + authorized signer)?
2) For automated PO ingestion we map incoming PO emails to an internal vendor code and a PO routing tag. Please include the following on your PO remittance instructions if your system allows a custom field: Redwood Vendor Code: AST-4591, Redwood PO Tag: RED-PO-PILOT
3) Please provide a copy of your ACH authorization or bank letter if you want ACH enabled now. If you'd prefer to receive checks, confirm remittance address and pay-to name.
4) Our finance team requires a separate vendor contact spreadsheet that lists the AP email for POs, remit, and invoice routing plus the billing contact who will reconcile invoices. Could you populate the attached template (we put your values in the first row) and return?

I copied Jordan (operations) and Priya (vendor ops) to handle mapping and ingestion; Kimberly (finance) will validate tax and payment method. Expect an intake ticket in our vendor portal within 24 hours; it will have a staging vendor id while we validate docs.

Next step: once we get the ACH or remit confirmation and your signed vendor intake form we can flip the automated ingestion switch and begin accepting POs directly into your procurement mailbox.

Thanks — Mateo
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
